title: Golden Temple & Vaishno Devi: 5 Days of Faith in the North
card_points: Harmandir Sahib and the Palki Sahib ceremony
Mata Vaishno Devi yatra from Katra
overview: Two of North India’s most visited shrines in one journey: the Golden Temple in Amritsar, where the langar serves free meals to everyone who comes, and the cave shrine of Mata Vaishno Devi in the Trikuta hills.
Spend two days in Amritsar, including the Beating Retreat ceremony at the Attari–Wagah border, then travel to Katra for the yatra — on foot, by pony or by helicopter where available.

good_to_know.title: Dress code
good_to_know.text: Traditional or modest clothing is recommended at all temples. Footwear is removed before entering.

good_to_know.title: What to carry
good_to_know.text: A valid photo ID, comfortable walking shoes, a water bottle and any regular medication.

good_to_know.title: Physical activity
good_to_know.text: The Vaishno Devi trek is about 12 km each way on a paved path. Ponies, palkis, battery cars and helicopters can be arranged, subject to availability.

good_to_know.title: Best time to visit
good_to_know.text: The yatra runs all year. March to June and September to November have the most comfortable weather; winters are cold at Bhawan.

faqs.question: Where does the tour start and end?
faqs.answer: The tour starts in Amritsar and ends with a drop-off at Jammu airport or railway station.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be customised?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can add or skip temples, change hotel categories, or extend your stay. Share your preferences when you enquire.

faqs.question: Is this tour suitable for senior citizens?
faqs.answer: Yes. Travel is by private vehicle and the pace is comfortable. Tell us about any mobility needs in advance.

faqs.question: Are special darshan tickets included?
faqs.answer: No, special darshan tickets are not included, but our team can help you book them where available.
